title: Name the practice snapshot by its content

cases.says: the same snapshot with every dictionary in another order has the same 64-digit digest; one changed cost or budget gives a new one
the store names a snapshot by its digest, keeps one file for content sent twice in another order, and reads the same content back
a rate of 0.0500000001 is the rate 0.05; a rate of 0.050001 is not
a cost profile is spent year by year, so reversing it is a different snapshot
a NaN rate has no canonical form and is refused with ValueError
the bytes are exactly the documented form, so the digest equals the one the planning team pinned
two fresh processes with different hash salts compute the same digest
a stored file edited in place is refused on read
putting the same content again does not rewrite its file, so an edit stays visible

origin.section: The Snapshot Is Named by the Hash of Its Canonical Content
